The first series on this site. It starts where every language model starts: raw text. It follows that text as it is split into tokens, turned into vectors, measured by similarity, mixed together by attention, and given a sense of order by positional encodings such as RoPE.

**Prerequisites:** some Python, and basic linear algebra (vectors, matrix products, eigenvalues). The companion pages linked from each article go deeper into the math and can be skipped on a first read.
